sum_features_personalized_text: Personalized suggestions based on user preferences and a range of different options—naturally supported by AI!
sum_features_multi_destination_text: Spare your visitors from installing yet another app. Join a network of destinations and get discovered by other users.

faq_a1: Yes — the app is completely free for visitors and users. For cities and destinations that want to partner and list their content on the platform, we discuss pricing individually based on the destination's needs.
faq_q2: How does CityBot help tourism destinations?
faq_a2: CityBot provides destinations with a branded mobile app experience for visitors, a CMS for managing attractions, tours, and events, real-time analytics, and AI-powered personalized suggestions — all at a fraction of the cost of building a custom solution. Over 130,000 personalized suggestions have been made through the platform.
faq_q3: Is CityBot available on iOS and Android?
faq_a3: Yes. The CityBot visitor app is available on both iOS (Apple App Store) and Android (Google Play Store), free to download and use for visitors.
faq_a4: CityBot is a Swiss startup founded and based in Zug, Switzerland, by a team of engineers with backgrounds in environmental engineering, mathematics, cybersecurity, and IT.
faq_q5: What does digital destination management mean?
faq_a5: Digital destination management refers to using technology platforms to organize, distribute, and personalize a destination's content — attractions, tours, events, and offers — for visitors via digital channels like mobile apps. CityBot provides this as a ready-to-use, cost-efficient platform so destinations don't need to build their own solution.
